nodes.name: namespace.yaml
nodes.summary: Defines the 'cosmos' Kubernetes namespace with standard app.kubernetes.io labels, providing the logical isolation boundary for all Cosmos workloads in the cluster.

nodes.name: configmap.yaml
nodes.summary: Kubernetes ConfigMap providing non-sensitive runtime environment variables for the Cosmos application pods, including NODE_ENV, LOG_LEVEL, gateway URL, and OpenTelemetry toggle.

nodes.name: secret.yaml
nodes.summary: Placeholder Kubernetes Secret manifest listing all required sensitive keys (DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, JWT_SECRET, Stripe keys); production values must be injected via AWS Secrets Manager through the External Secrets Operator at deploy time.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses stringData (plaintext) to document required keys; in production these should be supplied by External Secrets Operator rather than committed values.

nodes.name: web.yaml
nodes.summary: Defines the cosmos-web Deployment (2 replicas, port 4000, health probes on /api/v1/health) and its companion ClusterIP Service routing port 80 to 4000, with environment injected from ConfigMap and Secret.
nodes.languageNotes: Single file contains two YAML documents (Deployment + Service separated by ---), which is idiomatic for tightly coupled K8s resources.

nodes.name: kustomization.yaml
nodes.summary: Kustomize base configuration that assembles the core Cosmos Kubernetes manifests (namespace, configmap, secret, web deployment) into a composable base layer for environment overlays.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1 Kustomization kind to group the four base resources; overlays (staging, production) extend this base.
